INSIGHT: Ned discovered why he presents as less hyperactive than he is — he deliberately slows his speaking pace so System 2 can keep up and steer the conversation.

BEFORE: Thought he was moderately hyperactive (psychiatrist scored 4/9 adult). Didn't connect the speed throttling to masking.

AFTER: At full speed (which emerged during edible+meds session), System 2 cannot intercept fast enough. Rapid-fire thoughts and words come out unfiltered. He slows himself in normal conversation as a coping mechanism — makes him legible to others AND lets System 2 maintain control.

IMPLICATIONS: The psychiatrist's 4/9 adult score is a masking artifact. Real hyperactivity is likely 7/9 (his self-assessment, same as childhood score). The slow, controlled presentation isn't who he is — it's 24 years of compensation. On meds, the full speed is sustainable without chaos.
